name: Alicerod Kreisfer
original_name: アリスロッド・クライスファー
source:
"Sweet and dull. It's been like this for a long time."

Seal of Caderador Guardian of the East (Guardian) Raoul's best friend since their school days. He has a good family background and is an honor student. He's a cool beauty with a sharp tongue.

Since the incident six months ago, he feels indebted to Raoul...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.pandora.nu/kuro/game/tukai/t_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
